log.notes_to_self: Strategy: never kill gazette (sector) criminals. Kill national, East, podcasts, forum and foreign ones, about 9 a day, all as quick entries in the afternoon. Reason: afternoon deaths only rule out day workers, so L keeps 55% of people on routine. Skipping gazette keeps the pool above 1,000 unless 3 of my 4 kinds are reachable by L. 9 a day gives 45 deaths in 5 days, so x4 from about day 4. If a press conference shows the pool falling near 2,000, cut back to fewer kinds (drop the one I suspect is being traced).

Reason: afternoon deaths only rule out day workers, so L keeps 55% of people (about 55,000) on routine. Pool math: about 55,000 x 0.25 per reachable kind I use. 2 reachable kinds gives about 3,400 (safe). 3 reachable gives about 860 (caught). Risk: if L cannot reach sector, my 4 kinds (regional, age, forum, foreign) are all reachable except 1, so 3 reachable means caught. That happens in about 40% of games. Guess which kinds are traced from how fast the pool falls. If the pool is about 3,000 and stable, keep going. Day 1: 9 kills. Day 2: 9 kills.
